age: Patients with a critical COVID-19 course, as well as healthy controls (≥18 years of age), were enrolled in this study between 6 November 2020 and 22 February 2021.
cell_type: Platelets, the smallest cells in human blood, known for their role in primary hemostasis, are also able to interact with pathogens and play a crucial role in the immune response.

disease_state: This study aims to further elucidate the role of platelets in COVID-19 progression and to identify predictive biomarkers for disease outcomes.
material_type: In total, 200 ng of platelet protein underwent analysis through nanoLC-MS/MS, utilizing the previously described procedures.
sample_source: Venous blood samples were collected after admission to the intensive care unit (ICU) of the HDZ NRW (median: 2 days after admission).
